# MDL010: mdl-selector-empty-by-construction

A selector that cannot match anything whatever the repository holds.

For example `lang(rust) & lang(python)` or `a & !a`.

## Examples

### MDL010 selector empty by construction / A selector that contradicts itself fires #1 (line 6) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node a : trusted {
  owns lang(rust) & lang(python);
}
```

### MDL010 selector empty by construction / A satisfiable selector is clean #2 (line 16) (clean)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node a : trusted {
  owns lang(rust) & kind(function);
}
=== src/lib.rs
pub fn f() {}
```
